# MUBAR Store (https://www.mubarstore.com)
> Pakistan's Premier Destination for Luxury Men's Watches & Quality Timepieces at Affordable Low Prices.

Founded by Muhammad Mubashar in Lahore, Pakistan, MUBAR Store provides premium luxury timepieces with an uncompromising trust standard: **100% Verified Online Payment (JazzCash, SadaPay, NayaPay, EasyPaisa, Raast)** and **Free Nationwide Express Delivery**.

## Core Brand Values & Guarantees
- **Free Nationwide Express Delivery:** Zero shipping charges to Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and all nationwide locations.
- **Convenient Verified Online Payment:** Seamless transfers via JazzCash, SadaPay, NayaPay, EasyPaisa, and Raast Bank Transfer with fast WhatsApp verification.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 24–48 hours in Lahore; 2–4 business days across all major Pakistani cities.
- **7-Day Replacement Guarantee:** Full replacement warranty against manufacturing or transit defects.
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge:** Fast customer care, order booking, and payment verification via +92 308 4453846.
